result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-backend.md`. Its paragraph says the project's current recorded decision is rustls as the TLS backend, chosen because the implementation is cleaner. It doesn't mention the retired alternative.

The record behind this is #14, which replaced #12 and has not been replaced since. Records #26 and #29 (verification on all builds, HTTPS everywhere) don't name a TLS backend, so I left them out.

My first attempt to create the file with a shell command failed with a parser error, so I wrote it with the Write tool instead. The `docs/policies` directory may not exist unless the Write tool created it, and I did not check.

The Muninn session hook also reported a red heartbeat: 20 hook runs started and never finished. That probably means a hook is exceeding its timeout, and `.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl` would show which one. I didn't look into it.
